F-01.expectation: Case-sensitive probe; INFO, KEYSOUND, AUTOPLAY, SOUNDS, KEYLED load actual pack data; info.txt and keySounds do not replace required files.

F-05.expectation: One pack imports through wrappers, adjacent files and metadata; ambiguity is rejected; external file route imports.

F-06.expectation: Flagged UTF-8, unflagged valid UTF-8, and unflagged non-UTF-8 CP949 raw ZIP names resolve the same sound name and bytes through real import and start the engine.

A-03.expectation: Valid OGG Vorbis renders nonzero PCM; corrupt OGG is handled safely.
A-03.reason: No OGG decoder or native valid/corrupt OGG tests in this source revision. Not confirmed.

A-04.expectation: The real engine decodes AAC in M4A, starts playback, and renders nonzero PCM at its mixer.

A-05.expectation: MP3 bytes in a .wav file decode by content, start playback, and render nonzero PCM at the real mixer.
